name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Arr_of_arrAt
typeText:
∀ {m : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem} {a : Nat} {l : List.{0} Nat},
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.arrAt m a) l → DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Arr m a l

source.code:
theorem Arr_of_arrAt {m : Mem} {a : ℕ} {l : List ℕ} (h : arrAt m a = l) : Arr m a l := by
  refine ⟨by rw [← h, arrAt_length], fun i hi => ?_⟩
  have := arrAt_getElem m a i (by rw [h]; exact hi)
  rw [← this]
  simp only [h]
